scenes.title: Oh! Susanna
scenes.subtitle: D, G and A.
lines: This lesson teaches the chords D, G and A.
Susanna, a fun song that brings these shapes together.
We'll use three simple chords: D, A and G, with four beats per bar at 100 beats per minute.
Play along, and the app will listen — no chords, no rules, just you and your guitar.
